description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/3d-model-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL file"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Changes" name="Change requests"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Confirmation of satisfaction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Craving" name="Crave a custom 3D model"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Sketches" name="Send sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_STL" name="Receive STL file" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Changes" name="Tell the artist what to change" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Confirmation" name="Confirm satisfaction" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Choose_Color" name="Choose plastic color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Is the color at home?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Check_Amount" name="Check how much color is left"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Is it under 100 grams?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Add_ShoppingList" name="Add color to shopping list"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Order_Color" name="Order color"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorMerge" name="Continue with plastic" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Turn_On_Printer" name="Turn on the printer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Split" name="Heat printer and generate G-code" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Heat_Bed_Extruder" name="Heat bed and extruder"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status received" attachedToRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Receive_PrinterStatus" name="Receive printer status"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrinterStatus" name="Status received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Generate_Gcode" name="Generate G-code from the STL file"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Join" name="Heating and G-code ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Print_Model" name="Print the model"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Printing" name="Model printed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_01" sourceRef="Start_Craving" targetRef="Send_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_02" sourceRef="Send_Sketches" targetRef="Receive_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_03" sourceRef="Receive_STL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Send_Confirmation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[satisfied]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Send_Changes" name="Not satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_06" sourceRef="Send_Changes" targetRef="Receive_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_07" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Choose_Color"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_08" sourceRef="Choose_Color" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Check_Amount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[color is at home]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Order_Color" name="Not at home"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_11" sourceRef="Check_Amount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Add_ShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"><![CDATA[amount < 100]]></bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge" name="100 grams or more"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_14" sourceRef="Add_ShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_15" sourceRef="Order_Color" targetRef="Gateway_ColorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorMerge" targetRef="Turn_On_Printer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_17" sourceRef="Turn_On_Printer" targetRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_18" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Split" targetRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_19" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Split" targetRef="Generate_Gcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_20" sourceRef="Heat_Bed_Extruder" targetRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_21" sourceRef="Generate_Gcode" targetRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_22" sourceRef="Gateway_HeatAndGcode_Join" targetRef="Print_Model"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_23" sourceRef="Print_Model" targetRef="End_Printing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_24" sourceRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" targetRef="Receive_PrinterStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_25" sourceRef="Receive_PrinterStatus" targetRef="End_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Artist" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Sketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Create_Project" name="Create the 3D model project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_STL" name="Send STL file" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Artist_Wait" name="Wait for feedback or confirmation" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Changes" name="Receive change requests" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Revise_Project" name="Make requested changes"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Confirmation" name="Receive confirmation of satisfaction" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Artist" name="Project accepted"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_01" sourceRef="Start_Artist" targetRef="Create_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_02" sourceRef="Create_Project" targetRef="Send_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_03" sourceRef="Send_STL" targetRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait" targetRef="Receive_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_05" sourceRef="Receive_Changes" targetRef="Revise_Project"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_06" sourceRef="Revise_Project" targetRef="Send_STL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Artist_Wait" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Artist_08" sourceRef="Receive_Confirmation" targetRef="End_Artist"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" sourceRef="Send_Sketches" targetRef="Start_Artist" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_STL" sourceRef="Send_STL" targetRef="Receive_STL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Changes" sourceRef="Send_Changes" targetRef="Receive_Changes" messageRef="Message_Changes"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" sourceRef="Send_Confirmation" targetRef="Receive_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Boundary_PrinterStatus" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
